subject: Hosted API pricing — commit tiers / discount exception request
messages:
From: Sam Jordan <sam.jordan@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API pricing + commit tiers

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo earlier this week — the latency and streaming behavior looked promising. Our finance team asked for a clearer run at commercials before we move forward. Two quick asks: 1) can you share per-token pricing for hosted API (rate card) and the available committed-spend tiers you support, and 2) do you offer any custom per-token discounts for multi-quarter commits?

Attached is a rough forecast of expected usage for Q2–Q4 (ACME_usage_forecast.xlsx). We currently evaluate price vs. performance — would be helpful to see where Redwood lands if we commit to a 12-month spend. If the numbers look good, we want to run a pilot in April.

Best,
Sam
Sam Jordan
Director, Platform Partnerships
ACME Corp

Attachments: ACME_usage_forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Jordan <sam.jordan@acme.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing + commit tiers

Hi Sam — great to hear and thanks for the forecast.

Short answers:
- Rate card: our standard hosted API per-token list price is $0.0009 per input token / $0.0014 per output token (per current public rate card).
- Commit tiers: we support 3 tiers for hosted usage:
  * Bronze (monthly usage < $10k): list pricing, no commit
  * Silver (12-month commit $120k+): ~10–15% off list (tiered by volume)
  * Gold (12-month commit $360k+): up to ~25% off list with committed throughput SLAs
- Custom exceptions: we can consider deeper discounts for strategic deals or large run-rate customers, but these require internal approval (Sales Director + Finance sign-off; exceptions >20% need VP Sales approval).

Based on your attached forecast, you would be in the ~Gold range if you commit for 12 months — Ive attached a draft SOW we typically use for committed tiers. Two clarifying Qs before I push an internal pricing request: 1) is the spend youre describing a committed prepaid spend or an invoiced monthly commit? 2) are there data residency or audit requirements we should account for?

If you're okay, Ill open a formal pricing exception ticket with sales ops and loop in Rishi and Finance for approvals.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: ACME_SOW_Draft.docx (SOW template)
From: Sam Jordan <sam.jordan@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 07:36:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing + commit tiers

Marissa — thanks, that helps. Couple of clarifications from our side:
- We prefer invoiced monthly commits tied to a 12-month minimum, not prepaid.
- No special data residency constraints for the pilot (US only).
- Our procurement team will request a clause that caps escalation: if monthly usage exceeds the forecast by >30% we want a short-term overage band at a fixed incremental rate rather than immediate renegotiation.

We're aiming for a pilot that ramps to a steady-state spend of ~$45k/month by month three. If you can get to Gold-level economics (close to the 20–25% off list) for year-one committed spend, well push this into procurement.

—Sam
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Jordan <sam.jordan@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pricing + commit tiers — pricing exception request

Hi Rishi / Lauren / Priyom — forwarding ACME's ask. Key points:
- ACME is asking for Gold-level economics (~20–25% off list) in exchange for a 12-month invoiced monthly commit targeting ~$45k/mo run-rate (projected $540k for year one).
- They prefer monthly invoiced commits (not prepaid). Procurement will want an overage clause: if usage > forecast by >30% there should be a fixed incremental overage rate for the short term.
- Theyre strategic in platform partnerships and likely to expand into dedicated capacity later this year.

Request: can we offer a 22% off list per-token discount for year one with the following guardrails?
  * 12-month invoiced commit, minimum $45k/mo
  * Overage band: first 3 months of >30% overage billed at list * 0.75 factor, thereafter discussed
  * Legal to run standard SOW + procurement redlines

If you need margin numbers or expected TCV impact, I can attach the forecast and do a sensitivity. Need Sales Ops to generate the exception ticket if we agree.

Thanks — Marissa
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pricing + commit tiers — pricing exception request

Marissa — quick notes from Sales:
- ACME looks like a strong strategic partner; moving them to committed hosted spend increases stickiness and opens Dedicated later.
- Finance, please confirm margin at 22% off (Marissa: include cost-per-token estimate and expected utilization vs forecast).
- Approval thresholds: exceptions up to 15% are auto-approved by Sales Director. Anything between 15–25% requires Finance OK + VP Sales. >25% needs EVP sign-off.

Lauren / Priyom — can you confirm we can live with the proposed invoiced monthly cadence and the suggested overage band? If Finance signs off, I'll take this to VP Sales for final approval.

Rishi
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pricing + commit tiers — pricing exception request

Thanks — I reviewed the numbers off the attached forecast. Finance is comfortable approving a 22% discount for year one if:
- We get a signed 12-month MSA + SOW with monthly invoiced commitments and a clearly defined minimum monthly revenue ($45k).
- Overages are capped as proposed for the first 3 months (billing at list * 0.75), after which we reserve the right to renegotiate rates if usage is consistently >30% over forecast.
- We add a short clause limiting one unilateral price exception per account per 12-month period without executive reapproval.

If Marissa can confirm the SOW draft will include those terms, Finance will sign off and Rishi can take it to VP Sales for final sign-off. Please attach the forecast to the sales ops ticket.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
